title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.92
summary: Direkter MP4-Download von gesicherten Aufnahmeausschnitten ohne blockierenden HLS-Playlist-Aufruf.
changes: Authenticated direct MP4 cloud recording download endpoint without recording-segments preflight
15-second low-bandwidth standalone H264/AAC MP4 fragments, bounded at 3.5MB per HTTP response
Strict cloud allowlisting: no raw recording access or credential-bearing URLs
Dedicated bounded MP4 encode queue, 24-second camera agent fetch timeout for downloads
Private PHP 3.0.9: direct MP4 download button and selectable start minute on iPhone
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.92
description: Download secure short camera recording excerpts through private HTTPS portal without HLS streaming
releaseNotes: Install private PHP 3.0.9 first, then camera backend 2.20.92. Cloud MP4 downloads are limited to short 15-second excerpts to protect PHP-FPM and MySQL. Long full-quality exports remain local.
